objective: Validate bit-exact preservation of special binary32 values through the permutation.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata bits.
pass_condition: Pass iff each logical output bit pattern equals the bit pattern of the source element at the floor-mod coordinate, with no NaN payload or sign/zero changes.
setup: Fill the source logical region with a repeating sequence of bit patterns 0x7fc00001, 0x7f800000, 0xff800000, 0x00000000, 0x80000000, 0x00000001, and 0x007fffff; use width=32, height=8, pitch=32, shiftX=1, shiftY=-1; compute host expected values as bit patterns.
